answer: Cross-Epoch Neighborhood Prism: each agent’s epoch action graph is summarized as a permutation-invariant prism vector over partners, resource flows, and task classes. A consistency rule compares the latest vector with a decayed jade-weighted history and meadow-level cohort baselines; outliers are quarantined. Sybils must sustain correlated neighborhoods for K epochs, paying coordination, revalidation, and failed-quarantine costs while risking link disclosure.
